headline: Tata Steel Limited: Amalgamation/Merger
sum: Amalgamation/Merger - Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about Pronouncement of Order by the Hon ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench, approving and sanctioning the Scheme of Amalgamation amongst Tata Steel Limited and…
detail: Amalgamation/Merger - Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about Pronouncement of Order by the Hon ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench, approving and sanctioning the Scheme of Amalgamation amongst Tata Steel Limited and Rujuvalika Investments Limited and their respective shareholders
